rules.name: cs-21-unf-premium-deals-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT d.trade_id, d.contract_number, d.instrument, d.subportfolio, d.transaction_date, d.premium, d.original_lots, d.netting_status, d.netting_date FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs d WHERE d.contract_number LIKE 'UNF%' AND (d.transaction_date >= :fromDate OR d.netting_date >= :fromDate)

SELECT d.trade_id, d.contract_number, d.instrument, d.subportfolio, d.transaction_date, d.premium, d.original_lots, d.netting_status, d.netting_date FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND d.contract_number LIKE 'UNF%' AND (d.transaction_date >= :fromDate OR d.netting_date >= :fromDate)

SELECT c.client_code, c.currency, c.cob_date, c.opening_balance, c.expired_or_liquidated_cash, c.premium_paid_or_recd, c.commission, c.transfers_out, c.transfers_in, c.interest_charges, c.closing_balance, c.created_by, c.created_timestamp, c.updated_by, c.updated_timestamp FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.client_code IN ('UNF', 'ORM') AND c.cob_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-01' AND DATE '2026-11-12' ORDER BY c.client_code, c.cob_date, c.currency

SELECT c.client_code, c.currency, c.cob_date, c.opening_balance, c.expired_or_liquidated_cash, c.premium_paid_or_recd, c.commission, c.transfers_out, c.transfers_in, c.interest_charges, c.closing_balance FROM dbsystemuat.client_cash_account_balance_table_cfs c WHERE c.client_code IN ('UNF', 'ORM') AND c.cob_date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-12' ORDER BY c.client_code, c.cob_date, c.currency

expect.reason: new cash rows of UNF and ORM
